question: 2025-03 月 GMV 最高的前 5 个商品、其名称及所属一级类目？（用每日商品指标宽表的 gmv 列统计）
gold_sql: SELECT p.name AS product, p1.name AS category, SUM(d.gmv) AS total_gmv FROM daily_product_metrics d JOIN products p ON d.product_id=p.id JOIN categories c ON p.category_id=c.id JOIN categories p1 ON c.parent_id=p1.id WHERE d.date LIKE '2025-03%' GROUP BY p.id ORDER BY total_gmv DESC LIMIT 5

question: 平台整体退款率是多少？（退款总金额 / 订单明细销售总金额）
gold_sql: SELECT (SELECT SUM(amount) FROM refunds) / (SELECT SUM((unit_price-discount)*quantity) FROM order_items) AS refund_rate

question: 2025-01 月的订单量和订单总金额分别是多少？
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt, SUM(total_amount) AS amt FROM orders WHERE replace(substr(created_at,1,7),'/','-')='2025-01'

question: VIP 等级不低于 2、但在 2025-03 月一次都没下过单的用户有多少个？
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM users u WHERE u.vip_level>=2 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM orders o WHERE o.user_id=u.id AND replace(substr(o.created_at,1,7),'/','-')='2025-03')

question: 各一级类目在售商品的平均定价是多少？
gold_sql: SELECT p1.name AS category, AVG(p.price) AS avg_price FROM products p JOIN categories c ON p.category_id=c.id JOIN categories p1 ON c.parent_id=p1.id WHERE p.status='on_sale' GROUP BY p1.id

question: 2025-03 月缺货时长最长的前 3 个商品及其累计缺货小时数？
gold_sql: SELECT product_id, SUM(stock_out_hours) AS total_stockout FROM daily_product_metrics WHERE date LIKE '2025-03%' GROUP BY product_id ORDER BY total_stockout DESC LIMIT 3

question: 下单 3 次及以上的用户占全部下单用户的比例是多少？
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) * 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) FROM orders) AS repeat_rate FROM (SELECT user_id FROM orders GROUP BY user_id HAVING COUNT(*)>=3)

question: 2025-03 月人均会话数最高的前 5 个渠道及其人均会话数？
gold_sql: SELECT channel, SUM(sessions)*1.0/COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) AS sessions_per_user FROM daily_user_activity WHERE date LIKE '2025-03%' GROUP BY channel ORDER BY sessions_per_user DESC LIMIT 5
